baseline_models.focus_anchor: بَيَانَهُ, framed by ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا in 75:19.
baseline_models.mechanism: The expression-or-sign branch makes bayān the removal of semantic concealment: an intended meaning is disclosed through speech, writing, or another intelligible sign. The marked عَلَيْنَا assigns that work to the speaking Us, while the suffix keeps its object anaphoric.

activation_trace.role: Disclosing intended meaning by expression or sign supplies the ordinary semantic act and makes it a divinely borne undertaking.

changed_reading.before: Then its explanation is upon Us.
changed_reading.after: Then We emphatically undertake to disclose what it means through an intelligible expression or sign.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The noun بَيَانَهُ from ب ي ن, together with the result-ordering ثُمَّ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The appearance-and-uncovering branch permits a resultative reading: bayān is not only more wording about an object but the act of bringing that object or its import into evidentness.

activation_trace.role: Appearance and becoming clear shifts the result from verbal explanation to the referent itself becoming evident.

changed_reading.before: A verbal gloss will be supplied.
changed_reading.after: We undertake to make its import itself emerge as evident, whether by further words or by another mode of disclosure.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: بَيَانَهُ as a nominal formation from the root whose inventory includes separation and the interval between things.
baseline_models.mechanism: Clarity can be produced by separating what is compressed together and marking the intervals among its parts. Bayān therefore remains readable as articulation or differentiation, not merely paraphrase.

activation_trace.role: Separation and parting supplies the analytic motion by which fused material becomes distinct.
The interval or middle between things supplies discernible boundaries among the separated parts.

changed_reading.before: We explain it as an undivided whole.
changed_reading.after: We articulate it by setting out its internal distinctions, intervals, and boundaries.

context_deltas.mechanism: Collection turns dispersed material into a held whole, recitation voices that whole, and following tracks what is voiced; only then does bayān disclose intended meaning. The focus act is therefore a distinct post-reception operation rather than another name for recitation.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure by expression or sign supplies the semantic phase that follows delivery.
Gathering dispersed parts into one whole supplies the first divinely assigned stage.
Reading and recitation supply the delivered verbal form that precedes bayān.
Following behind supplies the receiver's ordered response between recitation and disclosure.

structural_cues: 75:17 and 75:19 repeat إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا for divine-side acts, while 75:18 assigns the addressee فَاتَّبِعْ.
فَإِذَا and ثُمَّ order collection and recitation, following, and bayān rather than merely listing synonyms.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies three sequenced actions and divided grammatical subjects; I infer a staged reception process and assign bayān the final semantic stage. A live alternative is rhetorical rank: ثُمَّ may elevate disclosure without requiring elapsed time.

changed_reading.before: Bayān restates or accompanies the recitation.
changed_reading.after: Bayān is the divinely borne phase after a collected recitation has been delivered and followed, converting reception into intelligibility.

context_deltas.mechanism: Physical tongue movement and haste are prohibited, whereas following is commanded. Against those receiver-side actions, عَلَيْنَا بَيَانَهُ reallocates control: clarity is not manufactured by racing to reproduce the sounds but received after disciplined tracking.

activation_trace.role: Meaning-disclosure supplies the act explicitly reserved to the divine side.
Movement opposed to stillness supplies the receiver's premature physical intervention.
The tongue as speech organ locates the prohibited intervention in vocal production.
Haste and premature advancement supply the pressure that misorders reception.
Following behind supplies the receptive action that replaces attempted vocal control.

structural_cues: The negative imperative in 75:16 and positive imperative in 75:18 frame two عَلَيْنَا clauses in 75:17 and 75:19.
The pronoun بِهِ recurs around tongue and haste before the suffix in بَيَانَهُ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prohibited movement and haste, commanded following, and repeated divine responsibility; I infer an allocation of epistemic agency in which comprehension cannot be forced by vocal control. The alternative is narrower: the prohibition may concern memorization only, leaving comprehension unaffected.

changed_reading.before: The addressee can secure explanation by rapidly mastering the wording.
changed_reading.after: The addressee relinquishes premature vocal control and follows; the speaking Us assumes responsibility for making the meaning clear.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah applies gathering both to bones and to recitation, while fingertip-level formation shows that assembly is completed by precise differentiation. The separation branch of ب ي ن consequently makes bayān the articulation of the gathered whole into distinct, usable parts.

activation_trace.role: Separation after connection supplies semantic articulation rather than mere accumulation.
Gathering dispersed bones supplies the first material instance of reconstituting a whole.
Straight, complete formation supplies the finishing operation after gathering.
Fingertips and extremities supply the image of fine-grained bodily articulation.
The same gathering motion applied to the recitation transfers the material pattern into the focus sequence.

structural_cues: ج م ع recurs for bones in 75:3, luminaries in 75:9, and the recitation in 75:17.
The opening places gathering bones and forming fingertips in consecutive ayat; the focus places bayān immediately after gathering and recitation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated gathering plus precise bodily formation; I supply the analogy that semantic articulation completes textual collection as fingertips complete bodily reassembly. The materially live alternative is ordinary explanation with no body-text analogy.

changed_reading.before: A complete utterance is collected and then separately explained.
changed_reading.after: What has been collected is completed by bayān: its parts and boundaries are articulated into an intelligible whole, like distinct extremities in a reformed body.

context_deltas.mechanism: Haste first disrupts reception and is then widened into a heart-level attachment to the immediate at the expense of the later. With ثُمَّ and the appearance branch of ب ي ن, bayān becomes clarity that arrives under a divinely ordered timing rather than something seized prematurely.

activation_trace.role: Becoming evident supplies clarity as an achieved result rather than an instantly possessed gloss.
Haste and premature advancement first identify the temporal error within reception.
Love lodged in the heart turns a momentary haste into an affective preference.
The advanced or immediate supplies the preferred near pole of the temporal contrast.
Deferral to a later time supplies the abandoned far pole and makes delayed clarification cognitively charged.

structural_cues: The root ع ج ل occurs in 75:16 before the focus and in 75:20 immediately after it.
75:20-21 oppose العاجلة and الآخرة, extending the focus sequence into a near-versus-later polarity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated haste root, love of the immediate, abandonment of the later, and ثُمَّ; I infer that impatience is an obstacle to disclosure and that bayān has a maturation horizon. The alternative is that 75:20 begins an unrelated eschatological rebuke.

changed_reading.before: Then explanation should be immediately available on demand.
changed_reading.after: Then clarity is brought to appearance in its proper divine sequence; attachment to immediacy is precisely what makes that process hard to receive.

context_deltas.mechanism: A delivered report, inward sight, and excuses imaged as curtains form an evidentiary mechanism: information arrives, the self can see it, and defensive coverings fail. Bayān thus acquires an adjudicative edge, making meaning and responsibility legible rather than merely offering neutral instruction.

activation_trace.role: Uncovering and appearance supply the exposure that defeats concealment.
Disclosing intended meaning supplies the communicative content of the exposure.
A report that comes and is delivered supplies accountable information about what preceded and followed.
Insight of the heart supplies the self's internal capacity to recognize the disclosed evidence.
Excuses as curtains supply the attempted screen that bayān's uncovering penetrates.

structural_cues: 75:13-15 move from being informed, to self-insight, to thrown excuses immediately before the tongue and recitation sequence.
The concessive وَلَوْ in 75:15 preserves self-evidence despite the production of excuses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies report, inward sight, and excuse-curtains; I infer the directional arrow that divine disclosure turns these into an accountability procedure. A live alternative keeps bayān narrowly pedagogical and treats 75:13-15 as a separate judgment scene.

changed_reading.before: Bayān helps a listener understand a difficult utterance.
changed_reading.after: Bayān also unveils the utterance's accountable import so that inward recognition cannot be permanently screened by excuses.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same repeated category of faces is split into opposed visible states, radiant and grimacing. This gives the appearance and separation branches of bayān an embodied output: disclosure makes the stakes discernible on the persons who receive their outcomes.

activation_trace.role: Appearance and becoming clear supply the visible mode of disclosure.
Separation supplies the differentiation of one repeated class into opposed outcomes.
The face standing for the self supplies the human surface on which an outcome becomes legible.
Radiant freshness supplies the positive visible state.
The repeated face-as-self keeps the contrasted state within the same displayed category.
Facial grimness and intense aversion supply the negative visible state.

structural_cues: 75:22 and 75:24 repeat وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ and change only the predicated facial state.
The paired descriptions follow immediately after the contrast between the immediate and the later.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a tightly parallel pair of faces with opposed visible states; I infer that this enacted contrast is one mode by which the focus's disclosure becomes manifest. The alternative is that the face pair illustrates consequences without specifying how bayān works.

changed_reading.before: Its meaning is clarified only in language.
changed_reading.after: Its import is also made visibly distinct in embodied outcomes: one repeated human category separates into unmistakably different states.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it lets the separation branch of ب ي ن and the later death sequence color a noun normally heard as explanation. It remains anchored in بَيَانَهُ and in the packet's exact parting-and-driving mechanism, but downstream prose should call it an eschatological overlay on clarification, not replace the ordinary semantic reading with a claim that bayān lexically means death.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: بَيَانَهُ through the root's separation-and-parting branch, with ثُمَّ allowing a later horizon.

activation_trace.role: Separation after prior connection supplies decisive disambiguation as a parting event.
Distinguishing and separating two things supplies the explicit final-parting counterpart to the focus branch.
Driving onward supplies the irreversible movement after separation toward the disclosed destination.

changed_reading.before: Clarity is exhausted by an explanatory statement near the recitation.
changed_reading.after: At the exploratory edge, its ambiguities are decisively severed at the final parting, when the person is driven into the reality the recitation disclosed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because it activates the root branch in which bayn is a tie between parties rather than the standard disclosure sense of bayān. It remains worth carrying because عَلَيْنَا, فَاتَّبِعْ, repeated Lordward movement, and turning away create an explicit relation of roles; downstream prose should present it as a relational resonance of disclosure, never as a lexical substitution.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The divine-side عَلَيْنَا joined to بَيَانَهُ, activated through the ب ي ن branch of a connection between parties.

activation_trace.role: A tie or connection between parties supplies disclosure as a maintained communicative relation.
Following behind supplies the receiver-side action that realizes the relation.
Lordship and sovereignty identify the relation's governing party and its direction.
Turning away supplies the receiver-side action that refuses or breaks the offered orientation.

changed_reading.before: Bayān transfers explanatory content from speaker to hearer.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory resonance, bayān also establishes a communicative tie whose receiver-side realization is following and whose failure appears as turning away.

strongest_changes: The immediate syntax turns bayān into a distinct divine phase after collection, recitation, and receiver-side following.
The prohibition of tongue movement and haste reallocates agency: the receiver follows, while disclosure remains عَلَيْنَا.
Whole-surah repetitions of gathering, precise formation, self-evidence, and contrasted faces expand explanation into articulation, evidentiary unveiling, and manifested outcome.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package made the focus act operate at several scales without forcing them into one reading: text is gathered and articulated like a body, delayed clarity opposes attachment to immediacy, and verbal disclosure can become visible evidence. The odd separation and relational branches remained traceable enough to preserve as contained outliers.
remaining_uncertainties: The suffix in بَيَانَهُ is immediately attracted to the recitation, but it is uncertain how far whole-surah enactments may widen its effective referent without overextension.
The body-text articulation model depends on a reader-supplied analogy; the packet establishes repeated gathering and forming but does not state that analogy explicitly.
It remains uncertain whether ثُمَّ marks elapsed sequence, rhetorical elevation, or both.
